# Steloom

Steloom is a platform for legal document analysis. It classifies documents, applies document-type-specific review scenarios (including SPA, NDA, employment agreements, and corporate documents), and produces structured outputs such as a DD grid, risks, and findings linked to the relevant section or annex of each document. The same review process is applied consistently to one document or to hundreds of files.
